verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Shopify POS data (orders, inventory) syncs with the Shopify back office and that POS UI extensions can call the GraphQL Admin API via fetch(), so some programmatic access exists. However, that access sits inside UI extensions embedded in the POS interface. Nothing documents a headless API that mirrors in-store UI actions such as building carts, taking payments, quick counts or receiving shipments. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage matching POS UI actions (cart/checkout, payments, staff/PIN management, stock counts), a documented parity claim, independent corroboration of API completeness.
